bio: You can really taste Martino Verbruggen's passion and experience in every bite of his dishes. His robust sauces are out of this world. Take, for example, the beautifully reduced veal jus that complements the succulent veal tenderloin and crispy sweetbreads. His cuisine is sophisticated and refined, with occasional international nuances adding an exciting twist. A judicious squeeze of kaffir lime adds a refreshing zing to the seasonal fish tartare. Hostess Loes is always on hand and contributes to the laid-back atmosphere that sets La Fleurie apart. A delightful dining experience!...
